name: No FIR for repeatable quests

description_html:
Just like the title says.

If you get a find some random shit from a repeatable and you have my luck and you can’t find the fukin item in the raid or you die before you extract with it then you understand the pain of having to do it again and again until you successfully completed it or you just go “fuk it, I’m not finishing this quest”.

So I made a little something that helps me complete the quest if I’m having difficulties completing it.
